items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: I'm not sure if I ever heard that Tom Turpin did

ctx.x: came out of this kind of thing you know those musicians.

Most of the ragtime players probably did read not all of them either. I think Chauvin didn't. I'm not sure if I ever heard that Tom Turpin did and there was a fellow that I recorded once Charlie Thompson who was quite a good ragtime player. He couldn't read but the tradition usually was I think that they could read and in order to play the complicated pieces and to do them accurately you would have to have either a sensational ear or be able to read those things to learn them very quickly.
